answer: Hypothesis: Interviews are the most commonly used technique for eliciting requirements in ML-enabled system projects — Q9_ML_Elicitation_Interviews was "quoted" (used) by 97 of 194 valid respondents (50.0%, 95% bootstrap CI [42.8%, 57.2%]), ranking first ahead of Scenarios/Prototyping (38.7% each), Workshops/Meetings (38.1%), Observation (33.0%) and Others (5.7%). The ranking is stable under project-level weighting: weighting respondents by their number of total ML projects (D7) gives Interviews 74.0% (CI [61.3%, 83.5%]) and by number of deployed ML projects (D8) gives 68.2% (CI [56.7%, 78.2%]; naive project-expanded CI [64.5%, 71.9%]). The D8-weighted (deployed-project) estimate of 68.197% is the closest grounded figure to the referenced benchmark anchor of 69.399% [69.062, 69.735] — reported as an anchor for comparison only, not a reproduced result, since that CI's width implies ~72,000 bootstrap units and cannot arise from 276 respondent rows (or 1,344 project pairs).

payload.hypothesis: Interviews are the most commonly used technique for eliciting requirements in ML-enabled system projects: they were quoted (used) by 97 of 194 valid respondents (50.0%, 95% bootstrap CI [42.8%, 57.2%]), ranking first ahead of Scenarios and Prototyping (38.7% each), Workshops/Meetings (38.1%), Observation (33.0%) and Other techniques (5.7%). This ranking is robust to weighting the sample by project exposure: weighting respondents by their total number of ML projects (D7) raises Interviews to 74.0% (CI [61.3%, 83.5%]) and weighting by deployed ML projects (D8) yields 68.2% (CI [56.7%, 78.2%]; naive project-expanded CI [64.5%, 71.9%]). The deployed-project-weighted estimate (68.197%) is the closest grounded figure to the referenced benchmark of 69.399% (95% CI [69.062, 69.735]), which is treated as an external anchor only — its CI width (~±0.34 pp) implies ~72,000 bootstrap units and cannot be reproduced from 276 respondents (or 1,344 respondent-project pairs).
payload.ranking_stability: Interviews first under all tested schemes (unweighted, D7-weighted, D8-weighted, both sensitivity variants, project-expanded)
payload.workflow: 1) Load CSV (276x202); 2) clean: drop -77 Q-blocks (valid N=194), treat -99/-66/negative Duration as non-response; 3) binarize Q9 'quoted'=uses technique; 4) compute per-technique proportions unweighted and weighted by D7_Total_ML_Projects / D8_ML_Production; 5) respondent-level cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 42) for percentile 95% CIs per scheme; 6) sensitivity: (a) exclude all 88 suspended (N=188), (b) add Q9_Others_Free text mentions; 7) project-expanded (respondent-project pair) replication check with naive bootstrap; 8) identify rank-1 technique per scheme and the proportion nearest the 69.399% benchmark anchor; 9) emit natural-language hypothesis. Outputs: analysis/elicitation_analysis.py, analysis/q9_proportions_bootstrap.csv.
